thread:
mira: Heads up — saw ~+18% unbilled token delta for EU invoice batch this morning. Correlates with the fallback routing change we pushed last night. Anyone else seeing duplicates?

ash: :eyes: digging. Which stage is emitting the invoice events — billing-ingest or usage-aggregator?

mira: billing-events topic shows multiple invoice events with same session_id but different route_id. quick query I ran:```sql
SELECT session_id, count(*) FROM invoice_events
WHERE region='eu' AND created_at >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY session_id HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
sample output: session_42 -> 7, session_77 -> 3

jules: that's the router failover change — we started attaching a new route_id when we fallback to the backup pool. Sounds like dedupe downstream uses route_id as part of the key.

billing-bot: alert: invoice-delta-eu > 10% (auto-notify) for window 2026-03-01..2026-03-19

ash: confirmed — aggregator dedupe key = (client_id, route_id, minute_window). If route_id mutates on failover, same session gets treated as new.

len: Suggested immediate mitigation: treat route_id as mutable and include original_region or original_route in the dedupe key. We already have X-Original-Route header on proxy. If aggregator reads that, duplicates vanish.

sam: Live change to aggregator dedupe logic is risky during high load. Alternative: run a targeted backfill that identifies duplicated session_ids in the last 24h and collapse those into single invoice events, then issue credits. Backfill is safer and reversible.

qa-squad: did a small staging backfill last night. For test-tenant we removed ~120 duplicate events, invoices aligned. No regressions in staging.

jules: long-term we should fix the router to set stable attribution headers on failover rather than generate new route_id. But immediate path: backfill + small hotfix in aggregator to prefer X-Original-Route when present.

ash: prepping a patch: aggregator: if X-Original-Route exists then use that in dedupe key; fallback to route_id otherwise. Adding unit tests for header precedence. Will open PR in ~30m.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: billing-aggregator v2.4.1 -> canary (3 pods)

mira: good. Also: console/ducks — the Admin Quotas dashboard currently only shows effective_route. We need both effective_route and original_route columns so SRE/finance can trace attribution after failover. Otherwise ops will be blind.

len: finance: we'll need a short runbook to credit affected customers if backfill doesn't fully reconcile. I'll draft messaging and the credit script.

sam: telemetry ask: add a histogram for events_per_session and a metric percent_duplicate_events_by_route. Put them on the billing inc dashboard with alert if duplicates > 1% for >10min.

mira: agreed. Also add an annotation on the dashboard for the router change time to help retrospective.

ash: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing-aggregator/pull/412 — change is small, tests included.

qa-squad: will kick a canary test with tailing logs, verify dedupe applied and no increase in latency.

deploy-bot: Canary passed health checks after 6m, 0 errors. Proceed to gradual rollout?

jules: go slow. Let it stabilize for 30m then 50% then full. Keep invoice-delta alerting on.

mira: ops/qa, start backfill job invoice-dedupe-2026-03-19 with window 2026-03-18T00:00..2026-03-19T06:00. We'll monitor invoice delta panels and per-tenant deltas.

ash: running backfill dry-run now, will post numbers in ~15m.

len: copying finance team and preparing credit ledger template. tagging @acct-team for visibility.

mira: thanks. If anyone finds edgecases (long-lived sessions, streaming tokens) call them out now — streaming sessions might produce many small events and need slightly different dedupe window.

sam: noted — streaming use-case: use session_fingerprint + sliding_window instead of minute_window. I'll add a note to the PR.

mira: perfect. Sync in #eng-platform in 30m if we need an ad-hoc. :thumbsup:
